description: OWASP Dependency-Track connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's software-supply-chain projects from a self-hosted Dependency-Track instance as `dependencytrack:project` items in the local index — the project name, version, classifier (APPLICATION / LIBRARY / CONTAINER / …), active flag, last BOM-import timestamp, tags, and the embedded vulnerability metrics (critical / high / medium / low counts, total vulnerabilities, and component count). Useful for answering supply-chain questions ("which projects have critical vulnerabilities?", "what's the SBOM coverage for the payment service?") without leaving Nimbus. Dependency-Track API-key auth (sent as the X-Api-Key request header). Dependency-Track has no universal SaaS host: the server host is supplied via the dependencytrack base-url vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by phase3AddDependencytrackMcp, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. The /api/v1/project endpoint paginates by pageNumber / pageSize (pageSize max 100); the connector walks a single forward page-number pass per cycle, capped. v1 indexes projects only — individual findings and components are a deferred follow-up. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
